newsitem.title: DUBAI: Sharjah to develop domestic gas network.
newsitem.headline: Sharjah to develop domestic gas network.

text.p: Sharjah Electricity and Water Authority (SEWA) has received government approval to lay a domestic gas distribution network in the emirate.

"SEWA has appointed PLE International Limited to undertake front end engineering design studies for this gas distribution network which will cover all residential, commercial and industrial areas in Sharjah city," SEWA and PLE International said in an advertisement published in local newspapers.
Sharjah, with a population of around 500,000, is one of the seven emirates that make up OPEC-member United Arab Emirates.
The advertisement invited potential contractors to bid for the project's main engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contract.
